summary: File drop zone drawn as a ripple simulation; dropped or picked files are listed with a simulated dotted progress bar.

events.name: files
events.description: Fires once per drop or file-picker selection that contains files, with every selected file.

events.name: uploaded
events.description: Fires per file when its simulated progress reaches 100%. `size` is in bytes. Not fired for files over 25 MB.

accessibility: The drop area has `role="button"`, `tabindex="0"` and `aria-label="Upload files: drop them here or press to browse"`.
The file list is an `aria-live="polite"` region.
A hidden native `<input type="file" multiple>` handles browsing. The ripple canvas is `aria-hidden`.
motion: With reduced motion the wave simulation, pointer ripples, random drips and marching border are off and the surface is static; list rows appear without fading in.
notes: Uploads are simulated and nothing is sent. Progress advances on a timer and `uploaded` fires when it completes; handle real uploads from the `files` event.
Files over 25 MB are marked too large. The limit and the `up to 25 MB each` text are fixed.
Up to six files per batch are listed and the list keeps the five most recent rows; `files` still carries every file.
Not form-associated: a `name` attribute has no effect and files are not submitted with a form.

data.note: Upload progress is simulated on a timer; only the file names and sizes come from the files the user drops.
